# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: Originally, 冃 as described in 冒 (cover) + 取# (take hold of) → grasp a container's cover and take a pinch of its (precious) contents → *extreme* (← extremely little/few ← small amount) → *most* (← amount approaching an extreme).
犯而取也。从冃从取。
曾也。从曰兓聲。《詩》曰：“朁不畏明。”
The relevant seal inscription form is a variant form of 介# (reduce) + 曾 (pile → mass) → mass gathering that reduces/eliminates space → *meet*; *assemble* → (conduct an) *interview*.
合也。从亼，从曾省。曾，益也。凡會之屬皆从會。
去也。从去曷聲。
益也。从會卑聲。
A depiction of a crescent *moon*, observed as a scooped-out portion of the full moon → *month*. *Monday* is a borrowed meaning.
闕也。大陰之精。象形。凡月之屬皆从月。

The relevant seal inscription form is as per 又# (right hand/arm) + 肉 flesh → extend the right hand/arm in shouldering a slab of meat → *have* (← hold) → *be*; *exist* (← have being ← have form ← object in a fixed point of space; compare 居, 在, and 存).
不宜有也。《春秋傳》曰：“日月有食之。”从月又聲。凡有之屬皆从有。

A depiction of a long string of shells threaded together and spread in alignment (compare 貫, also seashells pierced and strung together). *Friend* and *companion* are extended meanings (← figurative string of friends/companions).

The relevant oracle bone form of 𠬝 features the same elements as 及, a hand + a person → spread a hand over another person's back. A bronzeware inscription form adds 舟 boat → spread boards in fashioning a boat. A seal inscription form replaces 舟 with 肉 flesh → *clothes* that spread over/*cling* to the body → *submit*; *obey* (← be closely attached to; compare 伏) → *accede* → *take (medicine) regularly* (← submit to/obey a doctor's prescription) → *counter* (for a dose of medicine/a smoke). Also, *be engaged in* and *be accustomed to*. In the derivative characters 菔 and 鵩, 服 appears in slightly different forms.
用也。一曰車右騑，所以舟旋。从舟𠬝聲。
出# protrude + 月 moon → *crescent (new) moon* (protruding from the shaded portion; compare 外) → (dim) *light of a crescent moon*.
月未盛之明。从月、出。《周書》曰：“丙午朏。”
脯挺也。从肉句聲。
祭也。从肉兆聲。
晦而月見西方謂之朓。从月兆聲。

屰# reverse + 月 moon → moon reversing its course in completing its cycle → (astronomical) *conjunction* (← return, creating a conjunction of beginning and end points). Also, *first day of the (lunar) month*.
月一日始蘇也。从月屰聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 舟 boat (→ rounded object) + an element# combining 廾 pair of hands and a mark → hands stretched about a rounded object to raise it high → *royal we* (← elevate oneself in speaking). In derivative characters, 朕 may appear in the form seen for example in 滕.
我也。闕。
As per 良# (flowing stream) + 月 moon → stream of moonlight (compare 星) → *bright*; *clear* → *cheerful* (← bright personality).
明也。从月良聲。
照也。从月从囧。凡朙之屬皆从朙。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 臣 (staring subject/retainer) + 人 person ← gaze at the moon. In the bronzeware inscription style, which adds 月 moon, the 臣 + 人 components have morphed into a single element. A seal inscription form adds 亡# (obscure) → *wish*; *hope*; *desire* (← hopes/desires with only obscure chances of realization).
出亡在外，望其還也。从亾，朢省聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form shows plants + an element combining 日 sun/day and a variant form of 水 water → the rising sun, as seen between plants. A seal inscription form combines an abbreviated form of 乾 (the sun rising high in the sky) + 舟, here an abbreviated form# of 朕 (rise) → rising of the *morning* sun. *Dynasty* is an extended meaning, connected with the practice of issuing imperial commands at the beginning of the day.
As per 其# (square/rectangular) + 月 moon → *cycle*; *period* (← lunar cycle conceived of as proceeding around a square/rectangular backdrop; compare 稘 as well as 季 and 週).
會也。从月其聲。
月滿與日相朢，以朝君也。从月从臣从𡈼。𡈼，朝廷也。
As per 蒙# (cover/conceal) + 月 moon → *dimly visible moon*, hidden by cloud cover → *dim*; *hazy*; *obscure*.
月朦朧也。从月蒙聲。
As per 龍# (winding) + 月 moon → the (faintly visible) moon (compare 覇) winding through the sky → *hazy*; *dimly visible*.
朦朧也。从月龍聲。
A depiction of a large *tree*, the curving branches of which cover the ground beneath → *wood*.
冒也。冒地而生。東方之行。从屮，下象其根。凡木之屬皆从木。
分枲莖皮也。从屮，八象枲之皮莖也。凡朩之屬皆从朩。讀若髕。

A depiction of a tree with a diminutive, curved, and minutely visible branch obscured on top → *not yet*; *not be* (← not yet fully visible). *Sheep* (as the eighth sign of the Chinese zodiac) and *1 P.M. to 3 P.M.* are borrowed meanings. Originally the same character as 末.
味也。六月，滋味也。五行，木老於未。象木重枝葉也。凡未之屬皆从未。

A depiction of a tree with a diminutive, curved, and minutely visible branch obscured on top → *treetop*; *small*; *trifling*; *end*; *youngest child* (← extremity of a tree) → *period of decadence* (← decadent values marking the end of an age); (in) *the future* (← extremity of time). Originally the same character as 未.
木上曰末。从木，一在其上。

木 tree/wood + a horizontal line# (compare that in 旦) indicating the *base*/*root* of the trunk → *origin*; *originally*; *true*; *one's own*; *capital*; *counter* (for cylindrical objects) → *book* (← counter for scrolls ← counter for cylindrical objects).
木下曰本。从木，一在其下。

As per 乚# a variant form of 乙 (rise and hit a blocking element) + 木 tree/wood → *tag* (← small wooden/bamboo slat pinned or nailed into a blocking element) → *wooden slat* (on which to keep records); *letter*; *charm*; *talisman*; *card*; *paper currency*.
牒也。从木乙聲。
A depiction of *foxtail millet* being stripped of its grain right and left in passing through a sieve → (a particular) *herb*.
The relevant seal inscription form is 木# tree with a horizontal line through the middle, suggesting a stump → *red*; *vermilion* (← color of a freshly cut stump).
赤心木。松柏屬。从木，一在其中。

硃.explanation: 硃 distinguishes vermilion/cinnabar-related uses; 朱 remains in ordinary red and surname senses.
硃.example: 朱砂 → 硃砂 (differentiated spelling); 朱先生 → 朱先生
硃.usageCaveat: 朱砂 also occurs in traditional writing.
硃.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: Variant form of 樸: *simple*; *natural*; *plain*.
木皮也。从木卜聲。

樸.explanation: 樸 represents simple/plain/unadorned; 朴 may remain unchanged in surnames and other distinct lexical senses.
樸.example: 朴素 → 樸素; 姓朴 → 姓朴
樸.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: A variant of 垂 hang, consisting of 木 tree/wood + 乃 (cling) → (cling in) hanging → *hang*. Also (via the influence of 木), *branch* (← object that hangs from a tree).
樹木垂朵朵也。从木，象形。此與𥝩同意。
As per 力# (ripples) + 木 tree/wood → *grain* (of wood) (← ripple pattern). In Japan, 朸 has also been reinterpreted to mean a *carrying pole*.
木之理也。从木力聲。平原有朸縣。
几# desk/table + 木 tree/wood (for emphasis/clarification) → (wooden) *desk*.
木也。从木几聲。
高木也。从木丩聲。
丂# as described in 号 (extend then bend) + 木 tree/wood → tree *bending with rot/decay*.
橦也。从木丁聲。
A depiction of a twig with sharp, projecting points piled on the surface (that stab) → *thorn*. Compare 楚.
木芒也。象形。凡朿之屬皆从朿。讀若刺。
入 enter + 木 tree/wood → (wooden) *sluice/floodgate*. Compare 圦.
As per 于# (U-shaped) + 木 tree/wood → wooden *tub* or round *drinking vessel*.
干# thick bar; shield + 木 tree/wood → wooden *rod*, *pole* or *shield*.
Variant# of 于 (U-shaped) + 木 tree/wood → wooden, U-shaped *trowel* used in plastering → *plaster*.
所以涂也。秦謂之杇，關東謂之槾。从木亏聲。
As per 叉# (forked) + 木 tree/wood → *fork of a tree*; *Y-shaped tool*; *Y-shaped weapon*.
枝也。从木叉聲。
As per 彡# (hair-like pattern) + 木 tree/wood → tree with needle-like leaves → *cryptomeria*; *Japanese cedar*.
As per 兀# (shave a person's head) + 木 tree/wood → *stump* remaining after a tree has been cut → *branchless tree* with a crown of leaves at the top.
子# child/offspring + 木 tree/wood → *plum* (voluminous fruit; compare 梅).
果也。从木子聲。
口# mouth + 木 tree/wood → *apricot* (← tree fruit savored in the mouth). Compare 梅, a closely-related fruit thought to be beneficial for pregnant women on account of its voluminous production.
果也。从木，可省聲。
才# cut off + 木 tree/wood → cut off a resource in felling a tree → *wood*; *(raw) material* → *ability* (← raw material of an individual's nature).
木梃也。从木才聲。
As per 寸# (settle) + 木 tree/wood → settlement bordering or within woods → *village*.
桎杒也。从木刃聲。
勺# ladle + 木 tree/wood → wooden *ladle* → *ladle handle*.
枓柄也。从木从勺。
大# great + 木 tree/wood → *large tree* (particularly, one standing alone).
樹皃。从木大聲。《詩》曰：“有杕之杜。”
As per 丈# (a stick) + 木 tree/wood (for emphasis/clarification) → *walking stick*; *staff*; *cane*.
持也。从木丈聲。
棟也。从木亡聲。《爾雅》曰：“杗𢊺謂之梁。”
籆柄也。从木尸聲。
弋# stake + 木 tree/wood → *stake*; tethering *post*. 杙 was devised to replace 弋 after the latter came to used primarily in the senses of a tool or weapon.
劉，劉杙。从木弋聲。
平也。从木气聲。

As per 土# (pile) + 木 tree/wood → pile of tree fruit (pears) → variety of *pear* (Pyrus bretschneideri). *Obstruct* is a borrowed meaning. *Woods/grove in the vicinity of a shrine* is via a Japanese reinterpretation of the constituent elements of this character, 土 being understood as an abbreviated form of 社 (神社 = Shinto shrine).
甘棠也。从木土聲。
落也。从木也聲。讀若他。
己# arise + 木 tree/wood → *willow* (← tree with flexible branches that both bend and rise).
枸杞也。从木己聲。
The relevant seal inscription form is 木# tree/wood + a cord for bundling → compact firewood by wrapping a cord around it → *bundle* → *restrict*; *refrain*; *counter* (for bundled objects).
縛也。从囗、木。凡束之屬皆从束。
As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 木 tree/wood → *tree/plank stretched over a river as a bridge* (connecting one bank of a river to the other; compare 矼). Also, *flagpole* (stretching into the sky).
牀前橫木也。从木工聲。
木 tree/wood + 工 work/make → *woodworker*; *carpenter*.
木 tree/wood + 山 mountain → *timber forest*; *timber* → *woodcutter*.
As per 少# (small/slight) + 木 tree/wood → *treetop*; *tip of a branch*. Compare 末 and 未.
木標末也。从木少聲。
As per 亢# (stretch) + 木 tree/wood → *wooden stake* stretching straight upward. *Proceed* (over water) is a borrowed meaning.
削木札樸也。从木巿聲。陳楚謂櫝爲杮。
As per 不# (bulge) + 木 tree/wood → bulging wooden bowl (for soup/drinks) → *goblet*; *wineglass*; *sake cup* → *counter* (for cupsful). Also, *trophy* (← valuable goblet etc. given as a prize).

A depiction of a sack bound on two ends, with a stick run through it. *East* is either a borrowed meaning or an extended one, in the sense of the direction of the rising sun (the rays of which figuratively pierce the earth) → (in historical usage) *eastern Japan*.
動也。从木。官溥說：从日在木中。凡東之屬皆从東。
明也。从日在木上。
冥也。从日在木下。
As per 午# (mallet) + 木 tree/wood → *wooden mallet* → *pestle*. 杵 was devised to replace 午.
舂杵也。从木午聲。
木也。从木屯聲。《夏書》曰：“杶榦栝柏。”
As per 巴# (spread) + 木 tree/wood → tree spread through with voluminous fruit. The compound 枇杷 refers to the loquat. *Rake* is a borrowed meaning.
收麥器。从木巴聲。
軍中士所持殳也。从木从殳。《司馬法》曰：“執羽从杸。”
As per 予# (weaving shuttle) + 木 tree/wood → (wooden) *shuttle*. Variety of *oak* is a borrowed meaning.
機之持緯者。从木予聲。
械也。从木从手，手亦聲。
公# open + 木 tree/wood → *pine tree* (species with "open" fronds).
木也。从木公聲。
As per 反# (thin sheet) + 木 tree/wood → wooden sheet/*board*. Compare 版.
驢上負也。从木及聲。或讀若急。
屋櫨也。从木幵聲。
比# line up + 木 tree/wood → (clustered fruit of a) *loquat*.
枇杷，木也。从木比聲。
As per 王# (extend) + 木 tree/wood → strong wind (compare 凰) extending tree branches and forcing them to *bend* → *force* (v.); *distort*. Also, *perverse* and *in vain*.
衺曲也。从木㞷聲。
馬柱。从木卬聲。一曰堅也。
木。可作車。从木方聲。

As per 分# (split) + 木 tree/wood → lumber divided (by cutting or bending back; compare 反) into thin boards → *shingle*(s). Originally, however, the term may have referred to a tree the seeds of which scatter widely: compare 番.
榆也。从木分聲。
枎疏，四布也。从木夫聲。
梅也。从木冄聲。

Originally, 木 tree/wood + an element# (possibly a variant of 乍, but now written as 斤 ax) indicating cutting or chopping → split/*divide* wood by chopping it → *analyze* (← figurative division of elements in analyzing).
破木也。一曰折也。从木从斤。
行馬也。从木互聲。《周禮》曰：“設梐枑再重。”
木也。从木牙聲。一曰車𨊾會也。
斗# ladle + 木 tree/wood → wooden *ladle* or other object likened to a ladle → *wooden bracket*.
勺也。从木从斗。
As per 冘# as described in 沈 (sink) + 木 tree/wood → wooden *headrest* or *pillow* onto which the head sinks.
臥所薦首者。从木冘聲。
木少盛皃。从木夭聲。《詩》曰：“桃之枖枖。”
A depiction of two trees, suggesting a large number of trees growing alongside each other and encompassing villages (compare 村), sacred ground (compare 禁) and other spaces → *forest*; *woods*.
平土有叢木曰林。从二木。凡林之屬皆从林。

A variant form of 柮 (出 protrude + 木 tree/wood) → *tenon* (← projection on the end of a piece of wood, inserted into a mortise). 内 replaces 出 to indicate a shift in the initial consonant from T- to N-; compare 訥, 吶, 蚋, 汭 and 芮.
木# tree/wood + 攵 (stick held in the hand) → *stick*; *whip* → *one by one* (← count one by one with a stick) → *counter* (← inaugurate a count).
榦也。可爲杖。从木从攴。《詩》曰：“施于條枚。”

A depiction of a tree with round *fruit* hanging from a long branch → *result* (← fruit of effort); *fill*; *fulfill*; (← fully ripe) → *carry out*; *accomplish* (← fulfill) → *limit*; *end*; *come to an end*; *die* (← final result) → *as expected* (← end up as expected); *actually* (← turn out actually to be); *be at a loss* (← come to an end of resources).
木實也。从木，象果形在木之上。
支# branch + 木 tree/wood → *branch*; *bough*; *twig*. 枝 was devised to replace 支 after the latter came to refer to "branch" in primarily abstract senses.
木别生條也。从木支聲。

Unlike the use of 卆 in 卒 and in derivative characters based on 卒 that were devised in China, in the Japanese-devised 枠 it is intended to represent a spinning machine. 枠 adds 木 tree/wood → *frame* of a spinning machine → *limit*; *range*.
木 tree/wood + 升 a measure → wooden box for measuring out rice or liquor → *measuring box*.
木也。从木占聲。
古# hard; dried out + 木 tree/wood → *dried out* tree/wood → *wither*; *die*; *be seasoned*.
槀也。从木古聲。《夏書》曰：“唯箘輅枯。”木名也。
平也。从木从平，平亦聲。
耒耑也。从木台聲。
麻也。从朩台聲。

As per 只# (dispersal) + 木 tree/wood → *trifoliate orange tree*. T he function of 只 here is uncertain. "Dispersal" may be connected with properties of the tree or with the medicinal effects of the fruit.
木。似橘。从木只聲。
As per 叧# as described in 拐 (sever/separate) + 木 tree/wood → sever a branch from a tree and use as a *walking stick* → *cane*.
As per 号# (bend) + 木 tree/wood → tree bending with rot/decay (compare 朽) → *hollow* (← hollow stump of a decayed tree) → *empty*.
木根也。从木号聲。《春秋傳》曰：“歲在玄枵。”玄枵，虛也。
As per 加# (place atop) + 木 tree/wood → wooden framework atop which something is constructed → *put on*; *build* → *span*; *bridge girder*.
As per 加# (place atop) + 木 tree/wood → wooden restraining device placed atop the shoulders, and encasing the head → *shackles*; *fetters*.
柫也。从木加聲。淮南謂之柍。

As per 句# (bend) + 木 tree/wood → a bent/bending tree. The compound 枸梛 refers to a tree resembling a willow, 枸櫞 to a lemon tree (Citrus limon), and 枸杞 to Lycium chinense (known in English variously as Chinese desert thorn, Chinese teaplant or wolfberry).
木也。可爲醬。出蜀。从木句聲。
包# envelop + 木 tree/wood → *Quercus serrata* (variety of beech). The connection with "envelop" is unclear. *Stick*(n.) is a borrowed meaning via 桴.
擊鼓杖也。从木包聲。
世# successive + 木 tree/wood → *oar* (rotated in successive movements). *Tool for straightening bows* is a borrowed meaning.
楄也。枼，薄也。从木丗聲。
檆也。从木皮聲。一曰折也。
As per 它# (stretch) + 木 tree/wood → a long tie beam. In Japan, however, the character came to be reinterpreted as a variant of 舵 (*rudder* or *helm*).
木也。从木令聲。
As per 丙# (spread) + 木 tree/wood → spreading (= long) wooden *handle* → *shaft*; *grip*. *Design*, *pattern*, *figure*, (person's) *build* and *character* are borrowed meanings.
柯也。从木丙聲。
木也。實如棃。从木尼聲。
折木也。从木立聲。
冬# winter + 木 tree → *holly* (← tree the berries of which remain even after the onset of winter). Compare 檍.
梅也。从木央聲。一曰江南橦材，其實謂之柍。

付# attach + 木 tree/wood → *raft* (← vessel constructed by setting lumber in place). Also, *grip* (of a bow/sword etc.) (← hand attached firmly to a weapon) and *calyx* (part of a flowering plant to which sepals are attached).
闌足也。从木付聲。
白# white + 木 tree/wood → tree with whitish leaves, or which are coated with a white, waxy substance → cedar; *oak*.
鞠也。从木白聲。

木# tree/wood + 甘 (sweet food contained in the mouth) → plum (i.e., a dark fruit that grows in abundance, and is consumed by being savored in the mouth). Compare 梅. *A certain* and *some* are borrowed meanings.
酸果也。从木从甘。闕。
甘# sweet + 木 tree/wood → tree bearing sweet fruit → (mandarin) *orange*; *tangerine*; *citrus*.

The relevant seal inscription form is an element combining thread and a box for holding dye + 水 water (for emphasis/clarification) → *dye* (v.) → *soak*; *color* (v.); seep in*; *steep in*; *spot/smudge*; *stain*.
以繒染爲色。从水杂聲。
矛# pike/halberd + 木 tree/wood → *soft*/*pliant* wood made into curved weapon handles → *judo* (← pliancy).
木曲直也。从木矛聲。
樹搖皃。从木召聲。
As per 石# (substantial) + 木 tree/wood → (particular variety, or close relative of) *wild mulberry* (tree that bears a substantial amount of fruit).
桑也。从木石聲。
As per 甲# (press down upon) + 木 tree/wood → (lidded) *animal cage* → (place in a) *box*.
檻也。以藏虎兕。从木甲聲。
As per 由# (pass/run through) + 木 tree/wood → fruit juice run through a filtering device. In China, 柚 refers to the pomelo, and in Japan to Citrus junos (*citron*).
條也。似橙而酢。从木由聲。《夏書》曰：“厥包橘柚。”
木也。从木巨聲。
As per 斥# (split) + 木 tree/wood → split wood → pair of rectangular *wooden clappers* beaten by those on nightwatch.
判也。从木㡿聲。《易》曰：“重門擊𣔳。”
木也。从木乍聲。
氐# foundation + 木 tree/wood → *root* → *basis*. Compare 本.
木根也。从木氐聲。
木閑。从木且聲。
棱也。从木瓜聲。又，柧棱，殿堂上最高之處也。

匛# combines 匚 enclosure/frame + 久 (long and curved) → corpse in a *coffin*, the body curled rather than laid straight out. 柩 adds 木 tree/wood to denote a wooden coffin (in distinction to a stone sarcophagus or coffin made of other material).
棺也。从匚从木，久聲。
擊禾連枷也。从木弗聲。
Originally a sack (compare 東) + an abbreviated form# of 炎 (consuming blaze) → place a sack over a fire to separate the contents → *choose*/*select* (← choose between separated objects).
分別𥳑之也。从束从八。八，分別也。
棓也。从木犮聲。
斷也。从木出聲。讀若《爾雅》“貀無前足”之“貀”。
As per 可# (bend) + 木 tree/wood → L-shaped *ax handle*. Also, *stem* and *stalk*.
斧柄也。从木可聲。
果也。从木示聲。
As per 主# (stationary) + 木 tree/wood → cylindrical *pillar*; *post*; *column* → *support*; *stand up* (an object).
楹也。从木主聲。
欑也。从木必聲。
As per 卯# (bend) + 木 tree/wood → *willow* branches bending in a strong breeze.
As per 此# (line up irregularly) + 木 tree/wood → irregularly shaped pieces of *brushwood* or *firewood*.
小木散材。从木此聲。
As per 冊# (bamboo slats) + 木 tree/wood → enclosing *fence* made of wooden/bamboo slats → *palisade*; *weir* → *obstacles*; *bondage*.
編樹木也。从木从冊，冊亦聲。
《禮》有柶。柶，匕也。从木四聲。
An abbreviated form# of 祝 celebrate; commemorate + 木 tree/wood → wooden percussion *instrument* played on celebratory/commemorative occasions.
樂，木空也。所以止音爲節。从木，祝省聲。
As per 且# (pile) + 木 tree/wood → pile lumber in creating an *obstructive wooden fence*. *Investigate* is a borrowed meaning.

As per the right-hand element# of 姉 (irregular alignment) + 木 tree/wood → tree with notably irregular branches → *persimmon*. *Wood chips* and *shingle* are via reinterpretation of the constituent elements of the character as indicating irregularly shaped pieces of wood.
赤實果。从木市聲。
